findings.title: diff truncated; cannot verify full change set
findings.detail: The judge prompt states the unified diff is truncated at 120000 chars and mid-file (INTEGRATIONS.md cut at "cloudflar"). Without the remainder of the commit (app source, functions, tests, screenshots, SOURCES.md, etc.), any PASS claim for shipping completeness, route behavior, theme paint, API coverage, or brand assets is unverifiable. findings.detail: highWaterPct is set to 67.58 with a baseCommit. From the diff alone there is no test run output or coverage report proving this percentage was measured rather than hand-entered. Fabricated metrics cannot pass; claim is unverified.

findings.title: design archetype claim is metadata only
findings.detail: claims.json adds design.archetype "Timeline + rail". The _why text asserts this enables fe-design-archetype measurement, but the diff does not include design_audit output, screenshots, or production HTML proving the live UI matches that archetype. Metadata presence is not proof the UI implements it.

findings.title: prior-art docs present but partial/unverified
findings.detail: COMPETITORS.md and INTEGRATIONS.md are substantial (not empty stubs). INTEGRATIONS.md is truncated mid-table in the provided diff, and SOURCES.md is not shown in the visible portion. Content quality for fe-prior-art cannot be fully verified from the incomplete artifact. Visible competitor/integration analysis looks real, but completeness fails closed.

findings.title: design-ref HTML is static mock, not production proof
findings.detail: Option HTML uses hardcoded data-theme="light", static crop rows, and non-functional assistant controls. These are design references, not runtime app code. They do not prove production screens, a11y, or working filters. Preferring real defects: design mocks cannot substitute for missing screenshots/e2e evidence in this truncated diff.

findings.title: gitignore ok but no deploy/runtime evidence in diff
findings.detail: .gitignore correctly ignores node_modules, dist, .env, .dev.vars, playwright artifacts. That is fine. The commit message body (truncated) still does not show package.json scripts, wrangler deploy proof, or matching production asset hashes. Shipping claims cannot pass from .gitignore alone.
